strategies.name: Detection Strategy for Dynamic Resolution across OS Platforms

analytics.name: Analytic 0109
analytics.guidance: Correlate high-frequency or anomalous DNS query activity with processes that do not normally generate network requests (e.g., Office apps, system utilities). Detect pseudo-random or high-entropy domain lookups indicative of domain generation algorithms (DGAs).

tuning.description: Adjust based on environment to differentiate DGAs from legitimate CDNs
Interval for correlating bursts of DNS queries from the same process

analytics.name: Analytic 0110
analytics.guidance: Monitor /var/log/audit/audit.log and DNS resolver logs for repeated failed lookups or connections to high-entropy domain names. Correlate suspicious DNS queries with process lineage (e.g., Python, bash, or unusual system daemons).

tuning.description: Whitelist/blacklist tuned with external threat intel sources
Known safe daemons that frequently query domains

log_sources.name: linux:syslog
log_sources.channel: Query to suspicious domain with high entropy or low reputation

analytics.name: Analytic 0111
analytics.guidance: Inspect unified logs for anomalous DNS resolutions triggered by non-network applications. Flag repeated connections to newly registered or algorithmically generated domains. Correlate with endpoint process telemetry.

tuning.description: Age of domain registration considered suspicious (e.g., < 30 days)
Number of queries per process per time window

log_sources.name: macos:unifiedlog
log_sources.channel: DNS query with pseudo-random subdomain patterns

log_sources.name: macos:unifiedlog
log_sources.channel: Unexpected applications generating outbound DNS queries

analytics.name: Analytic 0112
analytics.guidance: Monitor esxcli and syslog records for DNS resolver changes or repeated queries to unusual external domains by management agents. Detect unauthorized changes to VM or host network settings that redirect DNS lookups.

tuning.description: Expected resolvers or DNS forwarders in ESXi configurations
Set of trusted external domains expected for ESXi host activity

log_sources.name: esxi:syslog
log_sources.channel: esxcli network vswitch or DNS resolver configuration updates
